_comment: Which headings in the Dark Sun Athascon guide are subclasses is stated by
the book itself, on its contents page. Transcribing that is deterministic;
guessing it from the prose is not - the difference between a subclass and
its first feature is a matter of layout, and a mis-classification puts a
feature into the choice tree as though it were a path you could take.
'Arcane Defilement' appears under Wizard in the contents but is a class
feature in the body ('NEW FEATURE: ARCANE DEFILEMENT'), so it is not here.
name: Dark Sun Player's Guide (Athascon)
_classSourceNote: Which printing of each class these subclasses attach to. The guide is a
2014 conversion - its cleric domains grant features at 1st level and its
feats cite the 2014 Player's Handbook - so they hang off the PHB classes.
The Psion is defined by this book itself, so its orders hang off DSA.
_classTableNote: The Psion's class table, transcribed from page 38. pdftotext renders it
column-major, so the Features column arrives as one undelimited run of
words - 'Psionics, Psionic Talents Telepathy Psionic Order Select a Feat
...' - which cannot be split back into rows by position. The numeric
columns CAN be read from the text, and the importer checks these against
them and complains if they disagree.
_spellListNote: Spells the guide REMOVES from a class list (chapter 7). These name
Player's Handbook spells, which the importer has no copy of, and the
tables are column-major - every name, then every level - so the names
cannot be split apart by position. Transcribed from pages 113-114.
The cleric's removals apply 'unless they are domain spells for their
chosen element', which the app does not model; a cleric of the Water
domain should put Create or Destroy Water back by hand.
_itemNote: Equipment tables. The importer reads these from the PDF and checks every
weapon that also exists in the Player's Handbook against its printed
damage die - 36 of the 37 it can check come out identical, which is what
tells you the columns did not slip.
'corrections' fixes the rows it gets wrong. In the martial ranged block one
row has its cost and damage on the same line of the PDF, which the column
reader will not accept as either column, and everything after it shifts.
Prices are in Athasian coin: 1 ceramic piece (cr) = 10 bits, 10 cr = 1 sp,
100 cr = 1 gp. Values are stored in BITS so they stay whole numbers.
_gearNote: Adventuring gear, tools and trade goods are NOT imported, on purpose.
The gear and tool tables are printed two-up across the page and run over
two pages, with category rows ('Alchemical Items', 'Arcane Focus') that
carry no price of their own. The names extract cleanly and so do the price
columns, but they do not reconcile to the same count, and an item silently
wearing the next item's price is the failure this importer exists to
Trade goods are a different thing again: they are priced per unit - '500 cp
/ ounce', '2 bits / gallon', '150+ cp' for a slave - so they are a rate
card, not inventory, and do not belong in an item list at all.
